A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research, renamed from MagicDriveDiT to MagicDrive-V2. Their complete main texts, equations, displays and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v2 reports original nuScenes and Waymo generation results, controlled ablations, VAE reconstruction measurements and human consistency evaluations.

after.justification: v4 retains those original results and adds inference timings, a qualitative MVDiT ablation and human text-control evaluation.

M1.justification: The MVDiT architecture, condition encoders, captioning, progressive training and sampling procedure are retained. Both versions already describe parallel VAE encoding/decoding in Appendix A. The preliminary equation correction does not establish a changed training algorithm.

E1.justification: nuScenes, Waymo and the existing image/video generation tasks remain. v4's six-condition text-control evaluation explicitly tests cloudy and foggy prompts alongside previously illustrated weather/time conditions (Appendix H, Figure IV), modestly extending documented test scenarios.

E2.justification: v4 adds Cosmos-transfer1 as an inference-speed comparator in Appendix D, Table III. Its single-view timing is reported, while its six-view row is explicitly estimated. Comparator membership in the retained generation-quality, VAE and human-consistency comparisons is unchanged.

E3.justification: New evaluations introduce diffusion-step, decoding and total-time measurements for specified video/GPU configurations, plus human assessment of text alignment across six conditions. The existing dataset splits, training schedules, generation metrics and retained experimental protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v4 adds a with/without-MVDiT qualitative ablation of cross-view consistency (Figure III), a class-level text-control confusion matrix (Figure IV), and an inference-cost breakdown. The existing VAE, temporal-encoding, mixed-training and rollout analyses are retained.

E5.justification: No new repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty intervals, error bars or significance-testing procedures are supplied. Existing human preference proportions are retained; the new confusion matrix reports recognition proportions without uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Tables 2–5, appendix training timings, VAE PSNRs and existing human consistency scores remain unchanged. v4 adds inference/decoding timings and a reported 3× decoding speedup in Table III, the MVDiT ablation outcome, and weather-recognition proportions with Figure IV diagonal entries of 0.70–1.00.

T1.justification: Section 3 revises the flow formulation: v2 gives the path (1−t)x0+tε and target (z−ε)/(1−t); v4 gives tz1+(1−t)ε and target z1−ε, explicitly defining z1 as the VAE video latent. This is a localized formal correction, with no new theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same architectural, control, captioning and mixed-training contributions, including generation up to 848×1600×6 and 241 frames. The added wording 'frame-wise' clarifies an existing geometric-control requirement.

C2.justification: v4 newly interprets its timing results as showing inference speed on par with Cosmos-transfer1 and its ablation as establishing MVDiT's importance for consistency. The earlier caveat that maximum-resolution, maximum-length inference is costly and excluded from primary numerical evaluation remains.

D1.justification: Appendix D adds inference hardware and GPU counts, CPU-offloading overhead information, decoding timings and an explicit statement that the implementation is open source. The project-page pointer changes with the rename. Parallel decoding and the main training/sampling hyperparameters were already documented.

R1.justification: v4 adds the Cosmos-drive-dreams citation supporting its Cosmos-transfer1 speed comparison and replaces the W-CODA organizer reference with a workshop report. The related-work narrative and positioning against earlier driving-generation methods remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: The title and method name change throughout, with limited rewrites in the abstract, introduction and architecture explanation. v4 adds acknowledgments and two appendix sections, updating subsequent references. Most prose and the main section sequence are retained.

P2.justification: v4 adds inference-speed Table III and the MVDiT-ablation and text-confusion Figures III–IV. Existing displays receive updated labels/captions and appendix reflow; the VAE table, rollout comparison and long-video examples are retained under new numbering.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly strengthens support for the architecture and text control, quantifies previously acknowledged inference costs, and clarifies the flow formulation while retaining the original evidence. These gains are limited by missing human-study sample sizes and a speed comparison using different hardware/settings and an estimated six-view Cosmos row. The revision improves documentation and validation without resolving a major deficiency.
